continuity.implementation: ContinuityRuntime + isolated PostgreSQL + real DBOS workflow history

postgres_dbos.implementation: independent SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL baseline + real DBOS workflow history

concurrency_probe.purpose: prove both actor submit-call windows overlap before unique-key winner selection

database_schema_versions.dbos_system_schema: managed by pinned DBOS package; version recorded below

fault_injector.implementation: separate loopback fault-proxy process with independently hash-chained telemetry
fault_injector.schedule_source: manifest scenario selected by controller; not mounted or keyed into arms

host_class: Docker Desktop Linux container on Windows x64; no host paths recorded

measurement_sources.cost_note: local Docker Desktop electricity/host cost is not monetized; null is intentional and forces evaluator EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE/inconclusive cost claims
measurement_sources.db_transactions: pg_stat_database xact_commit + xact_rollback delta in fresh per-trial PostgreSQL DB; includes runner barrier reads/control action; same harness operations per pair
measurement_sources.elapsed_ms: runner time.perf_counter_ns from first worker start through terminal/recovery result
measurement_sources.manual_interventions: 0: trial controller is scripted; no human control inputs during each timed arm trial
measurement_sources.model_cost_usd: 0.0: neither arm nor trial harness makes model/API calls
measurement_sources.operator_seconds: 0.0 per trial: no human intervention event; implementation/setup effort is separate and not measured
measurement_sources.provider_calls: fault-proxy count of upstream-forwarded POSTs; must equal separate provider ledger count
measurement_sources.recovery_actions: arm DBOS step counter (reconcile+verify) plus one for crash recovery worker invocation

paired_workload.grant_scope: exact resource + increment action + both actors + required source version

postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

preflight_tests.database_scope: separate disposable postgres maintenance DB; not any per-trial DBOS database

provider.implementation: separate loopback HTTP child process; append-only fsync/hash-chained JSONL ledger per arm trial
provider.ledger_exporter: provider_service.export_oracle in a separate provider-UID process
provider.provider_calls_metric: fault-proxy upstream-forwarded POST telemetry, independently cross-checked against provider_post_count
